name: sprite-foundry
description: AI sprite production workstation: generate characters, direct motion, repair frames, slice & pack sprite sheets, export game-ready animation. Zero runtime dependencies.

scripts.check: node --check server.mjs && for f in app/js/*.js app/js/lib/*.js app/js/ui/*.js app/js/ui/stages/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && echo SYNTAX-OK
